title: The Chef's Drinking Buddy and Kostya's Secret

scenes.title: The Morning After the Breakup
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov wakes up in Max's room after his breakup with Elena and drags Max out for a morning drink, promising to excuse his lateness at work.

scenes.title: Nastya's Father at the Bar
scenes.summary: Max gets official permission from Chef Barinov to be late, while Nastya's father visits Kostya at the bar and asks when he plans to marry Nastya.

scenes.title: A Job Offer
scenes.summary: Kostya refuses handouts from Nastya's father, who then offers Kostya a well-paid legal position at his meatpacking plant.

scenes.title: The Office at the Meat Plant
scenes.summary: Despite his fear of Nastya's reaction, Kostya is seduced by the high salary and leather chair at her father's meat factory and agrees to work part-time.

scenes.title: Katya's Diploma and the Chef's Arrival
scenes.summary: Vika asks Katya to bring her culinary academy diploma, while Chef Barinov arrives tipsy with Max and orders him to shout at the cooks.

scenes.title: The Chef's Sacrificial Lamb
scenes.summary: Senya warns Max about the stages of being the Chef's breakup buddy, and at three in the morning Chef Barinov calls Max in an emergency.

scenes.title: A Bet in the Underground Casino
scenes.summary: At an underground casino, Chef Barinov runs out of cash and wagers Max as a hardworking cook on the next hand.

scenes.title: Kostya's Second Job
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov celebrates winning at the casino with Max, while Kostya lies to Nastya that he got a second job at a sports bar.

scenes.title: On the Way to Tretyakovka
scenes.summary: Nastya dresses Kostya in an animal-rights T-shirt for comfort and accompanies him all the way to his supposed workplace.

scenes.title: The Housewarming Stage
scenes.summary: Senya teases Max about surviving the casino stage, and Chef Barinov tells Max to change clothes so they can move the Chef's belongings to Max's apartment.

scenes.title: Max's Plan in the Dining Room
scenes.summary: Vika catches Chef Barinov and Max drinking in the dining room, and Max proposes getting the Chef drunk enough to take him back to Lyova's apartment.

scenes.title: A Surprise from Nastya
scenes.summary: Max fails to get rid of Chef Barinov, and Nastya calls Kostya to say she is dropping by his sports bar in an hour.

scenes.title: How to Stop the Chef
scenes.summary: Max asks Senya and Fedya how they escaped Chef Barinov's past binges, then asks Katya how to make her father stop drinking.

scenes.title: Max and Katya's Idea
scenes.summary: Katya tells Max how her father once quit drinking after a scare in her childhood, giving Max an idea to shock the Chef sober.

scenes.title: Kostya in Someone Else's Sports Bar
scenes.summary: Kostya jumps behind the counter of a random sports bar to fool Nastya, confusing the real bartender until Nastya leaves.

scenes.title: The Staging in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: Max and Katya stage a fake aftermath and surveillance recording to make Chef Barinov believe he injured a stranger and attacked Katya while drunk.

scenes.title: The Chef's Promise and Nastya's Visit
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov vows to stop drinking and excuses Katya from showing Vika her diploma, while Nastya surprises Kostya at her father's meat factory.

scenes.title: A Conversation with Her Father
scenes.summary: Hiding under the desk, Kostya overhears Nastya praising his hard work and asking her father for a secret wedding loan so Kostya will not feel hurt.

scenes.title: Kostya's Confession and Katya's Secret
scenes.summary: Kostya confesses to Nastya and quits her father's factory, while Vika informs Katya that the Paris academy confirmed Katya was expelled.

scenes.title: Invisible Threads
scenes.summary: Max reflects on how every action changes the people around us, right before Chef Barinov discovers the intervention was staged and chases Max.
